evidence: The fully opened current Department of Business Informatics and Operations Management PhD information page explicitly invites doctoral research at that department and links its current PhDs in progress. The full current departmental doctoral-roster page lists active researchers on scheduling, production planning, material handling and other operational projects. The Faculty of Economics and Business Administration current doctoral-training page names PhD in Business Economics, PhD in Public Administration and Management, and PhD in Economics awards. These sources establish actual doctoral activity in an exact-title Operations Management department, but do not explicitly allocate a specific award title to the department's operations researchers. Do not infer that every departmental candidate receives the Business Economics award.
